question: Which of the following individuals thinks that the presence of beta-carotene in the algae gives the water its pink colour?
solution:
The correct answer is **'****Rahul Khot.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's have a look at the fourth sentence of the third paragraph of the passage: 

 
 
• *' *The vigorous growth of algae or bacteria having beta-carotene gives this type of characteristic colouration to the water. It is also related to increased evaporation, salinity, and the current hot and humid weather conditions,” said Rahul Khot, assistant director (in charge of the flamingo monitoring program).*'*
 
• *​*It can be concluded from the above line that* *Rahul Khot thinks that the presence of beta-carotene in the algae gives the water its pink colour. (यह निष्कर्ष निकाला जा सकता है कि राहुल खोत सोचते हैं कि शैवाल में बीटा-कैरोटीन की उपस्थिति पानी को गुलाबी रंग देती है।).
 
 
 
• *​*Hence, the correct answer is 'Rahul Khot.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 

 
• The meaning of the word 'vigorous' is* *very forceful or energetic. ('Vigorous' शब्द का अर्थ है बहुत जोरदार या ऊर्जावान।).

 
 
• Example:* There has been **vigorous** opposition to the proposals for a new road.*
